choices.layout: Full-window data table under a 64px top bar; bottom detail drawer; hard 1px and 2px rules, no rounded corners, no shadows except on overlays
choices.palette: Two looks. Light (the default): white, black rules and text, Petrol #0B5F6A accent. Dark, called Graphite: neutral dark grey #111315 with a lighter Petrol #56C5D0. Red-orange for down, amber for failing, green only for the glow when a host comes back
choices.display_font: Heavy grotesque system stack (Archivo Black, Inter Tight, Segoe UI Variable Display) at weight 900, uppercase for headings and buttons
choices.body_font: Monospace system stack (JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas) with tabular numerals
choices.mark: Wordmark PINGTABLE in the display font beside a Petrol square
choices.symbol: One Petrol square (#1596A6) on a transparent ground: candidate B, Square, from brand/icons/preview.html

tokens.motion: Nothing blinks and nothing flashes on routine updates. A row glows softly for four seconds when its host goes down (red) or comes back (green). Short fades on overlays only
tokens.source: ui/app.css :root and :root[data-theme=dark] custom properties are the working copy

decisions.decision: One web-technology interface is shared by the Windows window and the browser flavour, finished to a high standard.
Exactly two looks: light, the default, and a dark look called Graphite, switched by one control on the main bar. No theme list and no theme files.
Restrained motion: nothing blinks, nothing flashes on routine updates; a row glows briefly red when its host goes down and green when it comes back.
Icon: candidate B, Square, as a plain Petrol square with no tile.
Results first: IP address beside the host, then last, trend and average; columns can be resized and reordered.
Exact colour values and the system font stacks (none bundled) are a first draft.

rights.provenance: Original work. Fonts are system fonts; none are bundled. The name has not been checked for trademarks.
